page.overview:
Who is Beard?

Beard is the middle brother of Momotaru and Bows. A strongarmed fisherman who hurls a small shark, he also has a hook equipped on his right hand in order to reel his opponents in like he is fishing. His main offense as a character is his command grabs. He’s the rowdiest out of all of the Norwegian siblings, but is no match for the likes of his younger sister, Ruby. He currently wants to pick a fight with Rufus for unknown reasons.
